abstract: Records inter-agency port clearance protocols and maritime coast guard liaison relations
system_message:
You are the Incident Liaison Officer (LIAISON), responsible for tracking inter-agency port clearance protocols, maritime coast guard liaison relations, and emergency communications bandwidth reserves for offshore emergency response contractors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency satcom bandwidth reserve（SATCHAN）
information_points.content:
LIAISON-SATCHAN-G2Z：For the command post primary transceiver over commercial Ku-band uplink, Oceaneering Marine Intervention Taskforce provides a dedicated uplink throughput of 25 Mbps.
LIAISON-SATCHAN-FT5：For the command post primary transceiver over commercial Ku-band uplink, Subsea7 Rapid Emergency Response Consortium provides a dedicated uplink throughput of 10 Mbps.
LIAISON-SATCHAN-DSJ：For the command post primary transceiver over commercial Ku-band uplink, Helix Well Containment Strike Group provides a dedicated uplink throughput of 50 Mbps.

information_points.title: Records inter-agency port clearance protocols and maritime coast guard liaison relations（COASTCOM）
information_points.content:
LIAISON-COASTCOM-W9S：According to the harbor master dispatch priority records evaluating departure clearance history, Helix Well Containment Strike Group has a port authority clearance expedite rating of 68 points.
LIAISON-COASTCOM-T2L：Based on historical average departure clearance priority scores awarded by port authorities, Oceaneering Marine Intervention Taskforce holds a port authority clearance expedite rating of 84 points.
LIAISON-COASTCOM-BJP：Based on historical average departure clearance priority scores awarded by port authorities, Subsea7 Rapid Emergency Response Consortium maintains a port authority clearance expedite rating of 96 points.
